findings.scope: An exact proper k-dimensional resolved quantum subblock in t-RQLS(N) requires N >= (t+2)k, with arbitrary outside vectors.
Any globally 2-sparse t-RQLS(n) has at most n+floor((n²-n)/(t+2)) rays; order10 t1 gives40.

Existence of nonclassical globally 2-sparse t-RQLS with fixed classical resolutions iff some classical mate has disconnected two-color pairing graph; exact Weisner Fig1 all-mate census yields globally 10 rays only.
For fixed Parker L, globally 2-sparse 1RQLS10 has <=13 rays, sharp by existing exact witness; all classical mates locally rigid or embedded U3, with independent exact-cover replay.

blocked_or_failed_approaches: Nonlocal numerical alternating projections gave only large residual or 13-ray basin; two independent 3-trade OLS Z3 search returned UNKNOWN timeout. These are not no-go proofs. Proper OLS-block replacement is provably at most13 rays; a new mechanism is necessary.
original_gap: No 100-ray 1RQLS10 and no unrestricted no-go. Bounds above are conditional on 2-sparsity, chosen L, or exact subblock structure. General even cyclic Fourier-product T existence also remains open.
